text_block_list.text:
Lunchtime at Tracen Academy.
The Umamusume were spending it however they pleased.

Some eating their boxed lunches, some engrossed in books, 
some chatting with friends, and then—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Princess Home Run!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Another one over the fence?! Urgh...! 
Pitcher's hitting the showers...

I was asked to stand in as referee, 
but it turned into quite a one-sided game.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this is the power of a true princess! 
I shall knock it out of the park as many times as it takes!
choice_data_list: Umm, the replacement pitcher is...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I want to pitch! 
Thank you for having me!
choice_data_list: えーっと、代わりのピッチャーは……

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A warm welcome to you! 
Now then, bring it ooooon!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Throw a pitch hard enough to snap a bat in two, 
and overpower Kawakami-senpai. Phew...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: One mile, all my soul!!
choice_data_list: What a powerful ball...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Dosseeei!!
choice_data_list: なんて力強いボール……！

text_block_list.text: Mercilessly, the ball vanished into the distance...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haah... If she can hit that pitch, 
we don't stand a chance...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! 
Let's get the next batter out and turn this around!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you! 
I might not have Kawakami-chan's power, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Because I've still got this speed of mine!
choice_data_list: A line drive back to the pitcher!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: !! Caught it! Throw 'em out and change sides!
choice_data_list: ピッチャー返し！
choice_data_list_en: A line drive back to the pitcher!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I won't let you! Teyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wait, so fast! How many miles per hour are you doing!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Gran, don't just stand there watching! 
They're gonna run all the way home!

Hishi Akebono, with lightning speed, 
touched home plate...

And with the deficit at 9 runs, we were backed into a corner 
where conceding even one more run would trigger a called game defeat—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-senpai and Akebono-senpai, 
they really are strong! As expected of the Muses!
choice_data_list: You seem pretty pleased with yourself...?
You seem pretty happy about something...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it really reminded me that the Muse is the strongest! 
Isn't it amazing to have heights 
you just can't help striving for?!
choice_data_list: なんだか、嬉しそうだな……？
なんだか、嬉しそうだね……？
choice_data_list_en: You seem pretty pleased with yourself...?
You seem pretty happy about something...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
――I propose a special rule. 
Please take the next at-bat as well, Kawakami-senpai!
choice_data_list: Wait!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, a battle of power at the end, is it? 
Just as you wish, I shall knock it right out of the park for you!
choice_data_list: えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't challenge them with power. 
Because I know I can't win that way!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm taking this on with everything I've got! 
My reflexes, flexibility, dexterity—every last bit!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My repertoire spans infinite miles! 
Next time, I'll challenge you using everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Magic Pitchâ'Mile Spirit Baaall'!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What a bizarre trajectory...! 
Ngh, I will not lose~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Shaaa-orah, desu waaa!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: S-She hit it—even my magic pitch...!
choice_data_list: Game, set!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this is defeat. 
I couldn't match their power or their speed...
choice_data_list: ゲームセット！！

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, I still have a long way to go! 
I need to become even stronger!
choice_data_list: Nice fight, it was a great match!
Nice fight, that was a great match!
I hope you can catch up someday.
It'd be nice if you could catch up someday.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, I still have a long way to go! 
I need to become even stronger!
choice_data_list: ナイスファイト、いい勝負だった！
ナイスファイト、いい勝負だったよ！
いつか追いつけるといいな
いつか追いつけるといいね
choice_data_list_en: Nice fight, it was a great match!
Nice fight, that was a great match!
I hope you can catch up someday.
It'd be nice if you could catch up someday.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I feel like the gap between us and Muse 
has closed by at least five miles compared to before!
choice_data_list: ナイスファイト、いい勝負だった！
ナイスファイト、いい勝負だったよ！
いつか追いつけるといいな
いつか追いつけるといいね
choice_data_list_en: Nice fight, it was a great match!
Nice fight, that was a great match!
I hope you can catch up someday.
It'd be nice if you could catch up someday.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Next time, 
we'll show you an even more heated showdown!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Catch up... no, surpass them! 
Otherwise, I can't become the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Special training starts the moment we get back! 
All right, let's do thissss!!
